Hi Sara — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the notarized bank letter. A few short items to unblock PO creation: 

- Legal name: We require the legal entity name on the W-9 to match the name on the bank verification exactly (this is what our payments provider uses for ACH match). If there is a DBA shown on the W-9, please also include the legal name as the top line.
- Signed authority: We need an explicit signatory authority document showing that the CFO is authorized to sign vendor tax docs (either an internal board resolution excerpt or a signed signatory_authority.pdf).
- EIN verification: For our records we do a TIN match. You can provide the full EIN on a secure channel or confirm the last four digits; if you prefer we can share a secure upload link.
- DUNS (or business identifier): Optional but speeds onboarding for the vendor registry.

If you can send a corrected W-9 with the legal name in the top line and the signatory authority, we will trigger a TIN verification with compliance and route the PO to procurement.

If you are able to resend today we should be able to get the PO number assigned by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Vendor Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
